decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - Concurrent development. The respective parts of the development at 10 and 12 Bulstrode Avenue shall be carried out concurrently and all parts of the development shall be completed in full within two years of the commencement of the development.

Condition : 6 - Subject to appropriate safeguarding conditions, the proposed infill extensions, would be acceptable due to their position, design and appearance. The development would not harm the appearance of the area, neighbours' living conditions or highway safety and complies with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) and T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities for Developments) of the adopted Unitary Development Plan.
description: Erection of first floor rear infill extension to house at Number 10 and flat Number 12.  Erection of pitched roof over single storey rear extensions to both premises
